josh: Support -> CS escalation: Emerald Health onboarding ingest hitting intermittent 502/429 during bulk seed. AE marked renewal-risk; demo in ~14h. Need short comm + mitigation.

leah: Thanks. Do we have logs? Is this quota or runner latency? Need to craft what we tell the customer. :mag:

omar: paste: `2024-10-12T21:04:10Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=emerald qps=900 limit=600` then `2024-10-12T21:04:32Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-11`. No auth issues. Looks like burst > qps then runner tail latency.

omar: Ops options: (1) temporary tenant QPS bump for ingest window, (2) add short regional route to less-loaded zone, (3) ask customer to reduce concurrency & batch size. Command to bump: `infra tenant update-qps emerald --qps 1600 --note "trial seed bump"`

josh: Prefer avoid model changes to keep vectors consistent. Plan: bump qps + ask Emerald to run with 3 workers and batch_size=10 for tonight. Leah can you send CS note?

leah: Drafting now: "Hi Emerald team  quick note: were seeing intermittent throttling on bulk imports. For tonight please reduce concurrent workers to 3 and batch_size to 10. Weve applied a temporary capacity bump on our side and will confirm when stable. Expect an update in 20m." Send?

aj-bot: ae-bot: AE notified and account flagged renewal-risk.

omar: QPS bump applied at 1866000060. ops-bot: Incident INC-20241012-23 opened  priority=P1  emerald ingest. Monitoring started.

leah: Sent to customer at 1866000090. Customer ACKed and will throttle. They asked: will this change embeddings?

omar: Clarify: bump won't change model weights; embeddings unchanged unless we switch models. Sending note.

omar: 10m check @1866000600: error rate dropped ~80%, occasional 429s <1/min, CPU on model-runner-11 spiked then stabilized after autoscale. Keeping monitors 3h.

josh: Good. Action items: (1) ops monitor & remove bump after stability (omar), (2) CS follow-up recap post-demo (leah), (3) AE coordinate renewal playbook (ae-bot). Please include ingest best-practices in recap.

leah: Will prepare post-demo recap with timeline, impact, mitigation, and recommended long-term fixes (pre-warm, ingest chunking guidance, SDK helpers). Closing CS handoff unless errors recur. :white_check_mark:
